notes.title: Patch Notes | 02.09.2025
notes.content: [p]Deadhunters! A new update has rolled out for Zombie Army VR! As always a massive thank you to the slayers who have submitted bug reports and suggestions. Please check out a full list of notes below.[/p][p][/p][h2]Fixes[/h2][p][/p][h3]General[/h3][p]· Stability, performance and AI improvements[/p][p]· Art improvements including correction of floating weapons, and updates to textures for a selection of rifles[/p][p]· Small adjustments to Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese localisation where characters did not appear correctly[/p][p]· Haptic feedback now consistently performs across supported ProTube devices including the ProTube pistol[/p][p]· Added further haptic support for PSVR2[/p][p]· The Fowl Play achievement now consistently unlocks for both players in co-op after fulfilling the requirements[/p][p]· Fixed an issue where players could experience a softlock after removing their headset for a certain amount of time[/p][p]· Updated the PCVR rank list to reflect played hours, minutes and seconds rather than the previous incorrect numbering[/p][p]· Sniper zombies will now consistently focus on bait when bait mines are detonated[/p][p]· The path of bait and divine grenades thrown via triggers has been improved[/p][p]· The correct tooltip now appears for the zoom tooltip after switching the primary hand to the left[/p][p]· In co-op, zombies will now consistently target the alive player when the other player is in the downed state[/p][p]· The checkpoint progress warning for co-op will only trigger when players select ‘Quit to Hub’[/p][p]· Helmets removed from zombies will no longer jump off the floor when they are decapitated[/p][p]· Resolved an issue where players were unable to interact with medkits and syringes if they took a medkit out and then closed the Medbox door[/p][p]· When using Quest headsets in Link Mode via Oculus desktop app, the title audio will now automatically come out of the headset speakers until the player changes this via Windows audio settings[/p][p][/p][h2]The Tomented Garrison (Chapter 1, Level 2)[/h2][p]· The Claw hammer now blinks red to indicate damage to the weapon when hitting zombies[/p][p]· Removed an invisible wall near the door present in the Bunker area[/p][p]Camp Fear (Chapter 1, Level 3)[/p][p]· Resolved an issue where, under certain conditions, the initial zombies in the Farmstead South area could get stuck behind the gate[/p][p]· Fixed an issue where the previous waypoint marker to leave the safe room could fail to disappear after reloading the first checkpoint[/p][p]· Resolved an issue where, under certain circumstances, the waypoint marker on the lever for the final boss fight could fail to appear[/p][p][/p][h2]The Pit of Despair (Chapter 2, Level 2)[/h2][p]· Resolved an issue where players could partially fall through the stairs outside the Portal room located at the end of the level[/p][p]· Fixed an issue where players using teleport movement could get stuck after teleporting outside the airlock area[/p][p][/p][h2]The Lurking Fear (Chapter 3, Level 1)[/h2][p]· The Grab indicator now consistently highlights when players attempt to pick up ammo from the ammo crate in the corridor following the Upstairs Lab[/p][p]· Fixed an issue where zombies could be observed immediately falling to the ground after spawning in on a platform in the Reactor Silo[/p][p][/p][h2]Alarums (Chapter 3, Level 2)[/h2][p]· Resolved an issue where the chapter’s loading screen narration voice lines could overlap with the voice lines that play once players have loaded into the level[/p][p][/p][h2]From the Pinnacle to the Pit (Chapter 4, Level 1)[/h2][p]· The Grenadier will now melee attack players without fail throughout the gameplay[/p][p][/p][h2]The Harbinger of Doom (Chapter 4, Level 2)[/h2][p]· Removed an invisible wall attached to one of the ruined walls in by the floodlight in the first forest area[/p]

tags.bug: · The Fowl Play achievement now consistently unlocks for both players in co-op after fulfilling the requirements
· Fixed an issue where players could experience a softlock after removing their headset for a certain amount of time
· Updated the PCVR rank list to reflect played hours, minutes and seconds rather than the previous incorrect numbering
· Sniper zombies will now consistently focus on bait when bait mines are detonated
· The path of bait and divine grenades thrown via triggers has been improved
· The correct tooltip now appears for the zoom tooltip after switching the primary hand to the left
· In co-op, zombies will now consistently target the alive player when the other player is in the downed state
· The checkpoint progress warning for co-op will only trigger when players select ‘Quit to Hub’
· Helmets removed from zombies will no longer jump off the floor when they are decapitated
· Resolved an issue where players were unable to interact with medkits and syringes if they took a medkit out and then closed the Medbox door
· When using Quest headsets in Link Mode via Oculus desktop app, the title audio will now automatically come out of the headset speakers until the player changes this via Windows audio settings
· The Claw hammer now blinks red to indicate damage to the weapon when hitting zombies
· Removed an invisible wall near the door present in the Bunker area
· Resolved an issue where, under certain conditions, the initial zombies in the Farmstead South area could get stuck behind the gate
· Fixed an issue where the previous waypoint marker to leave the safe room could fail to disappear after reloading the first checkpoint
· Resolved an issue where, under certain circumstances, the waypoint marker on the lever for the final boss fight could fail to appear
· Resolved an issue where players could partially fall through the stairs outside the Portal room located at the end of the level
· Fixed an issue where players using teleport movement could get stuck after teleporting outside the airlock area
· The Grab indicator now consistently highlights when players attempt to pick up ammo from the ammo crate in the corridor following the Upstairs Lab
· Fixed an issue where zombies could be observed immediately falling to the ground after spawning in on a platform in the Reactor Silo
· Resolved an issue where the chapter’s loading screen narration voice lines could overlap with the voice lines that play once players have loaded into the level
· The Grenadier will now melee attack players without fail throughout the gameplay
· Removed an invisible wall attached to one of the ruined walls in by the floodlight in the first forest area

tags.bug: - Made further improvements to stability, performance and FPS throughout
- Made a large number of environmental art and killcam adjustments and corrections
- Made improvements to movement, handling and controls
- Improved zombie AI including animation, pathfinding and art fixes

tags.feature: - Added an angle adjustment slider for weapons
- Added a toggle to turn off bullet trails
- Added some clearer messaging regarding co-op saving

tags.balance_change: - Fire-rates for automatic weapons are now consistent between single player and co-op in all circumstances

tags.bug: - The game will now pause as intended when the players put down their Rift S headset
- The low health vignette will no longer appear when the Screen Vignette option is set to 'Off'
- The muzzle flare that appears when firing as has been realigned for several weapons
- The accuracy of weapons now consistently increases after upgrading 'Handling' from Workbench
- The Weapons Options menu now has the 'Reset to Default' and 'Apply Changes' buttons as intended
- Hermann's dialogue now triggers correctly when players complete the objective outside the Farmhouse
- Resolved an issue where the Grenade Tutorial could disappear off-screen if players paused the game for a short period of time
- The Tutorial video for Secrets and Skulls now triggers correctly when players take their first trip to the Courtyard
- The Z-Challenge for this level now only unlocks after completing correct requirements
- A dead body has been returned to its designated place in the area before the Bunker
- The voiceover that plays at the start of the level will now always trigger correctly
- The 'Clear the Approach' objective now only appears once at the start of the level
- Fixed an issue where the blood seal on the gate could fail to appear during the blood sigil encounter south of the Farmstead
- Resolved an issue where, under certain conditions, zombies would continue to spawn and attack players after defeating the Zombie Commander

tags.balance_change: - Damage to the Zombie Commander when he's vulnerable will now increase the score/multiplier timer as intended

tags.bug: - A zombie that was stuck inside the rock on top of tunnel during the 'Defend the generator' objective has now been relocated
- The Safe Room door is now in a location that is consistent with where it appears in a later chapter
- The green lava falls in the second temple room have been adjusted to better align and fall from the cliffs
- An invisible wall has been removed from the wooden plank walkway in the Inner Sanctum area

tags.balance_change: - The rat that runs through the corridor outside the second temple room has been slowed down to intended speed level

tags.bug: - The medal for the level’s Z-Challenge will now consistently unlock after fulfilling the required criteria
- Resolved an issue where a zombie would fail to attack/approach players after they have pulled the lever in the Lift Shaft area
- The error message from the robotic machinery in the Decontamination Chamber is now audible in all circumstances
- Resolved an issue where, under certain conditions, a waypoint marker would fail to disappear after players picked up a particular collectable
- The medal for the level’s Z-Challenge will now consistently unlock including when players throw grenades back at the grenadiers
- Resolved an issue where players were able to trigger the first checkpoint prematurely by clipping their head through the saferoom's door
- Fixed an issue where, in co-op, players’ characters could clip into each other while spawning into the level
- Removed an inappropriate fade to black at the end of the Grenadier scene
- Resolved an issue where the door of the hut in the second starting area be closed after reloading the second checkpoint
- Fixed an issue where players in co-op could get stuck before the door when entering the Huntress Cabin in certain circumstances
- Resolved an issue where, under certain conditions, a waypoint marker would fail to disappear after players moved into the Catacombs area
- A zombie in the crypt that could be seen climbing over nothing near the entrance of the catacombs has now been redirected
- Fixed an issue where the level’s voiceover and subtitles could fail to play if players were using teleport movement

tags.balance_change: - The pacing of the Zombie Commander transitioning to his vulnerable state has now been corrected

tags.bug: - Ammo cartridges will no longer disappear from the Gun Grunt zombies upon eliminating them in the Labyrinth area
- Resolved an issue where the Small Library Room waypoint marker could reappear after exiting the library
- All the zombies that are intended to drop down into the Labyrinth will now do so
- The Airlock door will now always close when players move forward into the Aqueduct Airlock area
- An invisible wall that was present above the curved wall located opposite the door in the Aqueduct area has now been removed
- It is now easier for players to crouch near the stairs before the Rocky Path Portal area
- The Z-challenge for the level will now always unlock after meeting unlock criteria
- Fixed an issue where the level’s voiceover and subtitles could fail to play if players were using teleport movement
- An idle Bucket Zombie near the Back Warehouse area is now moving again
- An Enraged Zombie that could be seen running in mid-air has now been grounded
- Resolved an issue where the waypoint marker appearing inside the Bucket Zombie container could fail to disappear after progressing further into the level
- A floating crow has been returned to a more natural position
- A few invisible walls in the Blood Fountain courtyard have now been removed
- Resolved an issue where, in specific cases, the last objective marker could fail to disappear on the mission complete screen after completion
- Fixed an issue where the level’s voiceover and subtitles could fail to play if players were using teleport movement

- Fixed an issue where, in certain circumstances, the waypoint marker for the Brigette Corridors could reappear after reloading the first checkpoint Fixed an issue where the level’s voiceover and subtitles could fail to play if players were using teleport movement

notes.title: High Octane Action: Zombie Army VR’s New Features Trailer
notes.content:
We're thrilled to share the brand new Features Trailer for Zombie Army VR. The new trailer showcases the [b]nail-biting action, precision gunplay, and brutal melee[/b] that players will experience as they battle to [b]overcome the undead masses[/b].

The first VR instalment of the hit Zombie Army franchise will launch on May 22nd on PC headsets via Steam. 

[i]Available to watch here:[/i]
[previewyoutube=sVF4UgM24TY;full][/previewyoutube]
 
[h2]Join the Deadhunters[/h2]
 
Set before the events of Zombie Army 4, in Zombie Army VR you [b]return to the field as one of the Deadhunters[/b], an elite squad that is hunting down zombie war criminals. You will [b]fight your way through undead hordes[/b] near the bombed-out city of Nuremberg and help Hermann Wolff, the Deadhunter’s legendary leader, find his scattered family and [b]fight to free Europe from the zombie apocalypse[/b].
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892715/2df3c992428cc9009db6e92f851abe02745345f8.jpg[/img]
 
[b]VR brings a new level of immersion[/b] to the nail-biting action of the Zombie Army series. Use both hands to [b]aim down the sights of your rifle[/b] and line up that perfect shot at range. When things get up close and personal, you can [b]use your gun to bludgeon the undead or scour the environment for items to use as melee weapons[/b]. You will also need to master reloading drills as the undead masses bear down on you from all sides. Overcoming your nerves and operating under pressure will be crucial if you are to succeed.
 
To help send the undead scourge back into the abyss, you will have access to [b]an arsenal of authentic World War II weaponry[/b] including sniper rifles, submachine guns, pistols, and more. You can also use Weapon Upgrade kits to [b]modify the damage, accuracy, and ammo capacity of your weapons[/b].
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892715/64c5a02de056e01ba8102f865c4a92159b097a25.jpg[/img]
 
[h2]Game Features[/h2]
 
[list]
[*] New high-thrills campaign
[*] Slay alone or take the fight online and join a friend for 2 player co-op
[*] Authentic World War II weaponry and impactful melee combat
[*] Relive devastating long-range shots with the signature X-ray Kill Cam
[*] VR enhances the expressive interactions & tactile experience of the Zombie Army franchise
[*] Player progression and weapon modification
[*] Competitive arcade-style scoring system
[*] bHaptics support on PlayStation® VR2, Quest and PCVR
[*] ProTubeVR support on Quest and PCVR
[*] Wide range of accessibility features
[/list]
 
For the latest news and updates, please visit [url=https://zombiearmy.com/en]zombiearmy.com[/url] and be sure to follow Zombie Army on our social channels: [url=https://x.com/zombiearmy]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/ZombieArmyTrilogy]Facebook[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/zombiearmyofficial/]Instagram[/url] and [url=https://www.youtube.com/zombiearmy]YouTube[/url]. We are excited to continue delivering thrilling experiences to our dedicated community and look forward to your ongoing support.

notes.title: Get Ready For The Apocalypse: Zombie Army VR Is Available To Pre-Order Now
notes.content:
Deadhunters,

News has reached the undead stomping frontlines that [b]Zombie Army VR[/b] will launch on [b]May 22nd[/b] on selective PC headsets via [b]Steam[/b].

Zombie Army VR is available to pre-order on [b]Steam[/b] now (Rift pre-orders are not currently possible). The apocalyptic [b]new trailer[/b] is also available to gaze at here.
[previewyoutube=i5t_puWPQ3k;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]A return to the end of the world[/h3]

Set before the events of [b]Zombie Army 4: Dead War[/b], in [b]Zombie Army VR[/b] you return to the field as one of the [b]Deadhunters[/b], an elite squad that is hunting down zombie war criminals. You will fight your way through undead hordes near the bombed-out city of Nuremberg and help Hermann Wolff, the Deadhunter’s legendary leader, find his scattered family and fight to [b]free Europe from the zombie apocalypse[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892715/af448dd3af714a0e867ed74882b1d00968716977.png[/img]

[h3]A new level of immersion[/h3]

[b]Use both hands[/b] to aim down the sights of your rifle and line up that perfect shot at range. When things get up close and personal, [b]use each hand independently to dual-wield pistols and submachine guns[/b]. You will also need to [b]master reloading drills[/b] as the undead masses bear down on you from all sides. Overcoming your nerves and operating under pressure will be crucial if you are to succeed.

To help send the undead scourge back into the abyss, you will have [b]access to an arsenal of authentic World War II weaponry[/b] including [b]sniper rifles, submachine guns, pistols[/b], and more. You will also need to earn XP to level up your Deadhunter as you fight across [b]zombie-infested 1940s Europe[/b], and use [b]Weapon Upgrade kits[/b] to [b]modify the damage, accuracy[/b], and [b]ammo capacity[/b] of your weapons.

notes.title: Zombie Army VR - Coming 2024
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892715/2764d58918a055e3c3ea4496ea244d34f49c8bfe.png[/img]

Bringing the Zombie Army franchise to VR for the first time, experience the fear, thrill and spine-chilling tension of the zombie apocalypse through the immersion of your headset. Coming 2024, Zombie Army VR will be available on PlayStation® VR2, Meta Quest 2, 3 and Pro, Oculus Rift, and PC headsets via Steam.

Developed in partnership with XR Games, you can view the Zombie Army VR reveal trailer here:
[previewyoutube=4F9R3rKlTRQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Following the story of the Zombie Army series, in Zombie Army VR you return to the field as one of the Deadhunters, an elite squad that is hunting down zombie war criminals. Fight your way through undead hordes near the bombed-out city of Nuremberg and help Hermann Wolff, the Deadhunter’s legendary leader, find his scattered family and fight to free Europe from the zombie apocalypse.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892715/40c6a4317fed94e23f31c5d7d221d36da20e4813.png[/img]

VR brings a new level of immersion to the nail-biting action of the Zombie Army series. Use both hands to aim down the sights of your rifle and line up that perfect shot at range or use each hand independently to dual-wield pistols and submachine guns for an up close and personal approach. Master reloading drills as the undead masses bear down on you from all sides, overcoming your nerves will be crucial if you are to succeed against the undead.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892715/d072f628c22f9e01252b51e8b85d972bc840c882.png[/img]

To help send the undead scourge back into the abyss, you will wield an arsenal of authentic World War II weaponry including sniper rifles, submachine guns, pistols, and more. Earn XP to level up your Deadhunter as you fight zombie-infested 1940s Europe, and use Weapon Upgrade kits to modify the range, accuracy, scope, and ammo capacity of your weapons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892715/3e4da2f21d9f4e6121872094831c97dd481079eb.png[/img]

Features:

[list]
[*] New spine-chilling campaign
[*] Authentic World War II weaponry and impactful melee combat
[*] Relive devastating long-range shots with the signature X-ray Kill Cam
[*] Player progression and weapon modification
[*] Slay alone or take the fight online and join a friend for 2 player co-op
[*] Competitive arcade-style scoring system
[*] bHaptics and Forcetube support on Quest and PCVR
[*] Wide range of accessibility features including colour blindness, audio, rotation options, and more.
[/list]

Be sure to follow our Zombie Army social channels to stay up to date on all things Zombie Army: [url=https://linktr.ee/zombiearmyofficial]Twitter, Facebook, Instagram and YouTube.[/url]
